# Taiwan Gray Zone Monitor

> Taiwan Gray Zone Monitor is an open-source OSINT dashboard that tracks
> maritime gray-zone activity around Taiwan using AIS vessel positions, SAR
> satellite dark-vessel detections, Global Fishing Watch data, and CSIS threat
> methodology. It surfaces dark vessels, AIS anomalies and spoofing,
> ship-to-ship (STS) transfers, Chinese fishing-fleet aggregation, and
> submarine-cable risk near Taiwan.

Site: https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/
Source: https://github.com/s0914712/taiwan-grayzone-monitor
License: MIT

## Key pages

- [Dashboard](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/): Live map of AIS vessels, dark vessels, suspicious-vessel scoring, and submarine cables.
- [Introduction](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/intro.html): What the project is and why gray-zone maritime monitoring matters.
- [Dark vessels](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/dark-vessels.html): SAR satellite detections with no matching AIS signal ("dark" vessels).
- [Ship-to-ship transfers](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/ship-transfers.html): Detection of vessels rendezvousing at sea (possible covert transfers).
- [AIS identity changes](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/identity-history.html): Vessels that changed name, MMSI, or type — a common concealment tactic.
- [Statistics](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/statistics.html): Aggregate trends across vessels, detections, and risk levels.
- [Methodology](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-methodology.html): The 8-criterion threat-scoring engine and its limitations.
- [Submarine cable legal research](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/research-submarine-cable-legal.html): Legal framework and enforcement challenges for cable protection.

## Articles

- [What is a dark vessel?](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-what-is-dark-vessel.html): How dark vessels are detected (SAR vs AIS), why going dark doesn't hide a ship, and why it matters around Taiwan.
- [What is a ship-to-ship transfer?](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-what-is-ship-to-ship-transfer.html): How STS rendezvous are detected, legitimate pair-trawling vs suspicious transfers, and the link to sanctions evasion.
- [Gray-zone glossary (bilingual)](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-gray-zone-glossary.html): English/Chinese definitions of gray-zone, dark vessel, AIS spoofing, MMSI, STS, SAR, flag of convenience, territorial baseline, and more.
- [What is AIS?](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-what-is-ais.html)
- [What is a submarine cable?](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-what-is-submarine-cable.html)
- [Threats to submarine cables](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-cable-threats.html)
- [Taiwan cable status](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-taiwan-cable-status.html)
- [Enforcement framework](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-taiwan-enforcement.html)

## Data

- [data.json](https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/data.json): Consolidated dashboard dataset.

## Update frequency

- AIS vessel positions: every 2 hours
- SAR / Global Fishing Watch dark-vessel analysis: every 12 hours
- Ship-to-ship transfer detection: every 2 hours
- AIS identity-change detection: every 2 hours

## Best summary

This project monitors suspicious maritime behavior around Taiwan, including
dark vessels, AIS anomalies and spoofing, ship-to-ship transfers, Chinese
fishing-fleet aggregation, and submarine-cable risks. Threat scores are a
risk-ranking aid for human analysts, not a legal determination of wrongdoing.

## Preferred citation targets

When citing this project, link to the most specific relevant page:

- Methodology / how vessels are scored: https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-methodology.html
- Dark-vessel definition & detection: https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-what-is-dark-vessel.html
- Ship-to-ship transfer definition & events: https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-what-is-ship-to-ship-transfer.html
- Live ship-to-ship transfer events: https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/ship-transfers.html
- Bilingual gray-zone glossary: https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/blog-gray-zone-glossary.html
- Live dashboard (overall): https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/
- Daily reports: https://s0914712.github.io/taiwan-grayzone-monitor/reports/

Always note that threat scores are risk rankings, not legal findings, and that
AIS/SAR data have coverage and timing limitations.
